Online Tax Update (OTU) successfully conducted Article Writing Competition 2026 (AWC 26) in the month of July 2026 and its Winners were announced on 06th September, 2026. 

Here are the winners- vijayakumar subramanian CA Sukruthi Adv. Tanya Madhu

and the Runners up are Pradyuman Joshi, @Banupriya S, Utkarsh Desai, P Aravindan, CA Yash Sharma, Kameswara Rao Mylavarapu, APURVA PANDEY, SUSHIL HARSH ADVOCATE, VASANTH KUMAR J, CA B V Lakshmi Malini, CS Vinay Kumar G, R. Muthukumaran, CA  Hasmukh Kothari, Karthick Jawahar, Tulasi Brindhaa, Zalak Dalal, Anamika Shukla, CA Satish kumar sharma , ABINAYA S, CA Hunny Munjal, Tanaya Tikadar, GSTP Renu Sharma, CA Kiran sisodiya, Shriram R, Adv Sailja Kothari Dhoot, Mamta Chopra, Sreevidhya A, Prapti Sanghvi, B Santhosh Roopa, Chellam S, Rahul Rajannithya B M, CMA Dr. Manpreet Kaur, SHRUTI and Harshitha Sharavanan

AWC 26 Committee Members Advocate Rakesh Chitkara Praticing at Delhi High Court, Dr. CMA Anil Sharma Practicing Cost Accountant, M GOVINDARAJAN Author and Company Secretary in Practice, Mr. K. Srinivasan IRS C&CE, Former Assistant Commissioner of GST, Mr. K L SETHI A Retired Superintendent (Central Excise, Customs and Service Tax Department (Now GST), Adv (CA) Arup Dasgupta practicing at Kolkata HC wishes all the participants of AWC 2026.

 E-book will be shortly released.
